key_discoveries.title: Postgres-Only Durable Execution
key_discoveries.description: Entire workflow engine runs as Postgres stored functions -- single absurd.sql file, zero additional services. Tasks decompose into steps with automatic checkpointing. On crash/restart, replays checkpoints and resumes from last completed step.

key_discoveries.title: Agent Skill Installation
key_discoveries.description: `absurdctl install-skill` injects Absurd skills into agent working directories (.agents/skills or .pi/skills). First-class support for agent-driven durable workflows.

key_discoveries.title: Event-Driven Task Suspension
key_discoveries.description: Tasks can suspend via `awaitEvent()` and resume when events arrive. Events are cached (first-emit-wins) and race-free. Maps directly to orchestrator patterns like waiting for PR creation or E2E test completion.

key_discoveries.title: Pull-Based Worker Model
key_discoveries.description: Workers pull tasks from Postgres as they have capacity. No push coordinator needed. Natural backpressure -- workers only take what they can handle.

key_discoveries.title: Multi-Language SDKs
key_discoveries.description: TypeScript, Python, and Go (experimental) SDKs. Complexity pushed into Postgres stored functions, SDKs are thin wrappers providing language-idiomatic ergonomics.
